race.description: Totally Workwear Country Boosted Mdn Hcp
race.comment: BEST DEFENCE (10) blinkers go on for the first time and ticks a few boxes from the good gate. Worked hard early from the outside draw to sit on the speed before fading in the straight to finish sixth over 1000m at this track. Has options from the draw and race experience can see him get the better of these. ALL SAINTS (9) resumes in a winnable contest from the rails draw. Placed at Kembla Grange four back over this trip. Claim helps and expected to go close. ZOUS APOLLO (14) slow into stride and got shuffled back from the rails draw with an okay fifth over 1000m at Tuncurry. Having his first run for the Todd Smith stable and looks to have genuine claims. OIOBOI (1) Bivouac gelding from a Not A Single Doubt mare on debut for the Wendy Peel yard. Looked good when winning his 800m trial. Tongue tie goes on and the claim helps. Keep safe.
